description.en: Important questions on the highways, railways, ports and waterways of India for Assam competitive exams.
description.as: ভাৰতৰ ৰাজপথ, ৰেলপথ, বন্দৰ আৰু জলপথ সম্পৰ্কে অসম প্ৰতিযোগিতামূলক পৰীক্ষাৰ বাবে গুৰুত্বপূৰ্ণ প্ৰশ্ন।

q.en: What is the total length of the road network of India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ মুঠ পথ নেটৱৰ্ক দৈৰ্ঘ্য কিমান?

a.en: About 63 lakh kilometres, the second largest in the world.
a.as: প্ৰায় ৬৩ লাখ কিলোমিটাৰ, বিশ্বৰ দ্বিতীয় বৃহত্তম।

q.en: Which is the longest National Highway of India?
What is the length of the NH 44?
Which is the longest National Highway of the world?

a.en: The NH 44 was once part of the Asian Highway, but the Pan-American is the longest.
a.as: NH 44 এবাৰ এছিয়ান হাইৱেৰ অংশ আছিল, কিন্তু পেন-আমেৰিকান দীঘলতম।

q.en: What is the 'Golden Quadrilateral'?

a.en: The highway network connecting Delhi, Mumbai, Chennai and Kolkata.
a.as: দিল্লী, মুম্বাই, চেন্নাই আৰু কলকাতা সংযোগী ঘাইপথ নেটৱৰ্ক।

q.en: What is the total length of the Golden Quadrilateral?
What is the 'North-South Corridor' of India?

a.en: The highway connecting Srinagar with Kanyakumari.

q.en: Which is the longest railway zone of India?
What is the total length of the railway network of India?
q.as: ভাৰতৰ মুঠ ৰেল নেটৱৰ্ক দৈৰ্ঘ্য কিমান?

q.en: When was the first railway started in India?
q.as: ভাৰতত প্ৰথম ৰেল কেতিয়া আৰম্ভ হৈছিল?

q.en: Which is the longest railway platform of India?

a.en: The Gorakhpur railway station in Uttar Pradesh.
a.as: উত্তৰ প্ৰদেশত অৱস্থিত গোৰখপুৰ ৰেল ষ্টেচন।

q.en: Which is the longest railway tunnel of India?

a.en: The Pir Panjal tunnel in Jammu and Kashmir.
a.as: জম্মু আৰু কাশ্মীৰত অৱস্থিত পিৰ পাঞ্জাল সুৰংগ।

q.en: What is the length of the Pir Panjal railway tunnel?
q.as: পিৰ পাঞ্জাল ৰেল সুৰংগৰ দৈৰ্ঘ্য কিমান?

q.en: Which is the busiest railway station of India?

a.en: The Howrah railway station in West Bengal.
a.as: পশ্চিম বংগত অৱস্থিত হাওড়া ৰেল ষ্টেচন।

q.en: Which is the first railway station of Assam?

a.en: The Dibrugarh railway station, opened in 1882.
a.as: ১৮৮২ চনত মুকলি হোৱা ডিব্ৰুগড় ৰেল ষ্টেচন।

q.en: Which railway zone covers the North-East India?
q.as: উত্তৰ-পূব ভাৰত কোন ৰেল জ'নৰ অধীনত?

q.en: Where is the headquarters of the NFR?
How many major ports are there in India?
Which is the largest port of India?

a.en: The Mumbai Port and the Jawaharlal Nehru Port (Nhava Sheva).
a.as: মুম্বাই বন্দৰ আৰু জৱাহৰলাল নেহৰু বন্দৰ (নাভা শেৱা)।

q.en: Which is the oldest port of India?
Which is the deepest port of India?
Which is the largest container port of India?
Which is the easternmost major port of India?

a.en: The Kolkata and the Paradip ports.

q.en: Which is the newest major port of India?

a.en: The Vadhavan port in Maharashtra (announced recently).

q.en: How many national waterways are there in India?
Which is the National Waterway 1 of India?
Which is the National Waterway 2 of India?
Which is the National Waterway 3 of India?

a.en: The West Coast Canal in Kerala.

q.en: Which is the longest National Waterway of India?
Which is the largest river port of India?

a.en: The Kolkata port on the Hooghly river.

q.en: Which is the southernmost major port of India?

a.en: The Tuticorin port in Tamil Nadu.

q.en: Which is the westernmost major port of India?
Which is the only major port of the North-East India?
q.as: উত্তৰ-পূব ভাৰতৰ একমাত্ৰ মুখ্য বন্দৰ কোনখন?

a.en: There is no major port; the nearest is Kolkata.

q.en: What is the 'Inland Waterways Authority of India'?

a.en: The authority that develops and regulates the national waterways.
a.as: ৰাষ্ট্ৰীয় জলপথ বিকাশ আৰু নিয়ন্ত্ৰণকাৰী প্ৰাধিকৰণ।

q.en: When was the Inland Waterways Authority of India established?
q.as: ভাৰতীয় অন্তৰ্দেশীয় জলপথ প্ৰাধিকৰণ কেতিয়া স্থাপিত হৈছিল?
